pages.title: Discussion - DMH Art Doll Club | dmh sculptures

metadata.description: Welcome to our club! Here, you can connect with other members of the doll community, get studio updates, participate in GiveAways, and share pictures and videos.😍 I want to have a space where we can share some demonstrations of materials and techniques for our silicone kits.😍 This group is open to all doll collectors and artists who want to share and read about topics of interests surrounding vinyl Reborn and Silicone Art Dolls. Only authentic kits are permitted. Any suspicious activity should be reported directly to me.
